subject: Sizing scenarios for CloudLeaf deal — region-by-region GPU allocation
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@cloudleaf.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudLeaf Procurement <procurement@cloudleaf.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial workload profile + region ask for dedicated capacity

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a concrete profile so your planning team can size dedicated capacity ahead of contract. High level:

- Users: 200 concurrent app sessions initially, expected to grow to 800 over 12 months.
- Workload: mixture of short chat prompts (avg 64 tokens) and longer generation requests for documents (avg 1024 tokens) at ~20% of QPS.
- Model targets: H100-equivalent for fastest latency on doc generation; A100-80GB acceptable for chat.
- Regions: primary in us-west-2 for our customers, secondary EU (Frankfurt) for GDPR customers, APAC (Singapore) pilot in Q3.
- SLO: p95 latency <= 250ms for chat, 800ms for doc generation under normal load.

Can Redwood propose a few allocation scenarios (conservative / baseline / aggressive) with rough monthly cost and lead time to provision pools in each region? Procurement also needs an estimate for committed vCPU/GPU hours for our legal team.

Attaching our internal capacity requirements PDF.

Best,
Sara

Attachment: CloudLeaf_MSP_capacity_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@cloudleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jan 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial workload profile + region ask for dedicated capacity

Sara —

Appreciate the detail, that helps a lot. We're happy to size & present three scenarios per region (conservative / baseline / aggressive). Quick clarifications before we finalize numbers:

1) Peak concurrency definition: is 200 concurrent sessions peak or sustained for a 3-hour window?
2) For document generation, are those single long calls (1k tokens) or streaming multi-chunk responses?
3) Any plan to use embeddings or reranking that would change qps to the embeddings endpoint?

I'll pull together estimates and loop in Infra for lead times. Karthik — can you run the throughput calc for H100/A100 variants given p95 targets and sequence mix? Marissa — can you include committed-hour pricing tiers (monthly committed vs burst) as another column for procurement?

Rishi
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial workload profile + region ask for dedicated capacity

Rishi / team —

Ran a couple of quick scenarios against realistic perf numbers (H100-80GB and A100-80GB). Assumptions: avg chat token 64, doc gen 1024, 20% doc gen ratio, batching enabled for chat with 30ms batching overhead, KV cache hit assumed 15% (prefix reuse).

Summary (per region):
- Conservative: 6 H100 GPUs (us), 4 H100 (eu), 2 A100 (apac pilot). Expected sustained QPS ~180 chat-equivalent, p95 chat = 230ms, doc p95 = ~700ms. Lead time: 3–4 weeks for hosted/Dedicated pools (depends on quota), 6–8 weeks if customer wants in their VPC.
- Baseline: 12 H100 (us), 6 H100 (eu), 4 A100 (apac). Sustained QPS ~420, p95 chat = 180ms, doc p95 = 500–600ms. Lead time: 4 weeks hosted, 8–10 weeks VPC/on-prem procurement cycle.
- Aggressive: 20 H100 (us), 10 H100 (eu), 6 H100 (apac). Sustained QPS ~900, p95 chat < 150ms under normal load, but requires dedicated autoscaling policies and larger KV memory. Lead time: 6+ weeks and requires procurement commit.

Notes:
- H100s give meaningful latency benefit for long-context doc generation. If CloudLeaf is sensitive to cost, mixing A100s for chat and H100s for doc nodes is the most cost-effective.
- For GDPR routing we can keep EU pool isolated with its own key management; that adds ~1 week to setup.

Attaching my spreadsheet with per-GPU throughput math and monthly committed-hour pricing for each scenario.

Attachment: rishi_gpu_scenarios_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial workload profile + region ask for dedicated capacity

Adding the cost tiers and procurement notes — draft summary below that I can paste into Procurement's spreadsheet:

- Baseline (recommended): US: 12 H100 equivalent -> est $XXXk/month committed (30% discount on list for 12mo commit). EU: 6 H100 -> est $YYYk/month. APAC pilot: 4 A100 -> est $ZZZk/month.
- Procurement ask: initial 6mo commit to reduce lead time + pricing risk. Add SLA add-on for 99.9% uptime on dedicated pool.

Open items for CloudLeaf: exact Horizon for APAC pilot (start date), confirmation on whether VPC deployment required for EU pool, and any encryption/HSM specifics.

I'll prepare a one-page deal appendix and send to Procurement once CloudLeaf confirms.

Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@cloudleaf.com>, CloudLeaf Procurement <procurement@cloudleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Final: CloudLeaf dedicated-capacity scenarios and next steps

Sara —

Thanks for the initial requirements. Attached are the three scenarios (conservative/baseline/aggressive) with per-region GPU counts, expected p95 latencies, lead times, and committed-hour pricing. Quick recommended path: baseline across US/EU with APAC as an initial pilot (4 A100) and a 6-month commit to shorten provisioning time and secure the committed discount.

Immediate asks for CloudLeaf to unblock procurement:
- Confirm APAC pilot start quarter (Q2 vs Q3).
- Confirm whether EU pool must be in CloudLeaf VPC (GDPR/legal ask) or if Redwood-hosted EU Dedicated pool is acceptable.
- If VPC required, we need an estimated procurement window (3–6 weeks) and contact for network/VPN setup.

Next steps on our side once you confirm: final pricing appendix + contract appendix (we'll include clear capacity rollback clauses and an auto-fallback plan to lower-tier model variants if utilisation drops).

Link to HubSpot deal CL-2026-0419: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CL-2026-0419
Internal planning doc: https://redwoodinternal.company/docs/deploy/gpu-scenarios-v2

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
